instruction: Add finance@outlook.com to the CC field of this email.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully attached aws-bill.pdf to Thunderbird compose email in 5 turns. Clicked Attach button, navigated to Home directory, selected aws-bill.pdf, clicked Open.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with Thunderbird compose window UI: toolbar buttons, file dialogs, file selection. Navigates file browser and attaches files.
metadata.task_rationale: The agent proved it can interact with compose window elements. Adding a CC recipient requires clicking the CC button to reveal the field and typing an email — a related compose window interaction at similar difficulty.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a CC recipient. Evaluator reads the accessibility tree of the compose window and checks if the expected CC email address appears in the tree content.

scoring_breakdown.cc_field: 1.0 - Accessibility tree contains 'finance@outlook.com' in CC context

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the accessibility tree of the Thunderbird compose window, which will contain CC field contents.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_cc').
Expected value 'finance@outlook.com' is semantically correct for the instruction.
Coverage is complete: single instruction requirement (add CC) is checked by single evaluator.

Minor issue: metric checks if the email appears anywhere in the accessibility tree rather than specifically in the CC field context. The email could theoretically appear in the body or other fields, producing a false positive.
Postconfig (activate_window + sleep) is appropriate for ensuring the compose window is visible and accessible.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Improve the metric to parse the accessibility tree structure and verify 'finance@outlook.com' appears specifically in the CC field context (e.g., look for a CC label/node nearby), rather than anywhere in the full tree content.
